content.text:
The image shows a benzene ring with an OH group on each of two opposite (para) vertices, one on the left and one on the right. This is hydroquinone (1,4-dihydroxybenzene).

The ring has three double bonds, drawn at the top, lower left, and lower right. The ring carbons are the two substituted ones plus four CH carbons, and there are no stereocentres.

SMILES: Oc1ccc(O)cc1
